history.title: 13 Saal Ki Neha Banin Bihar Ki Sabse Kam Umar Ki Netradan
summary_bullets: 13 saal ki neha banin bihar ki sabse kam umar ki netradan
Rajyastar par karyakram mein parivar hoga sammanit
Neha ki netradan ki kahaani bahut prernadayak hai

history.title: Patna Ka JP Ganga Path Ban Gaya Yuvaon Ka Favorite Spot
summary_bullets: Patna ka JP ganga path ban gaya yuvaon ka favorite spot
Ganga kinare khubsurati aur sukoon ka perfect combination
Yuvaon ko yahaan bahut pasand aa raha hai

history.title: Madhepura Mein Bhakpa Karyakartaon Ne Sadak Par Ropi Dhani
summary_bullets: Madhepura mein bhakpa karyakartaon ne sadak par ropi dhani
Jaljamav se virodh, shasan-prashasan ke khilaf nare
Jal nikasi ke liye karyavahi ki ja rahi hai

history.title: Muzaffarpur Mein Aniyantrit Scorpiao ATM Mein Ghusi
summary_bullets: Muzaffarpur mein aniyantrit scorpiao ATM mein ghusi
Gadi chhodkar chalak farar ho gaya
Mamle ki jaanch mein jutti hai police

history.title: Bihar Ke Sarkari Schoolon Mein Half Day Vyavastha Phir Laagu
summary_bullets: Bihar ke sarkari schoolon mein half day vyavastha phir laagu ki gayi hai
Shiksha vibhag ne is sambandh mein adesh jari kiya hai
Shanivar ko 9:30 baje se school band ho jayenge

history.title: Bihar Mein TB Marizon Ko Badi Raahat: Prakhand Se Seedha Milega Yojana Ka Paisa
summary_bullets: Bihar mein TB marizon ko badi raahat mili hai
Prakhand se seedha milega yojana ka paisa
Bhugtan mein deri par karyavahi hogi

history.title: Bihar Mein Baadh Ka Kahar: Gandak Nadi Ufnai, Darjon Gaon Mein Sadkon Par Bah Raha Hai Pani
summary_bullets: Bihar mein baadh ki samasya bahut badi hai
Gandak nadi ufnai, darjon gaon mein sadkon par bah raha hai pani
Logon ko surakshit sthanon par pahunchaya ja raha hai

history.title: Bihar Mein Rozgar Ki Samasya: 15-20 Hazaar Ki Job Ke Liye Shahar Chhodna Pad Raha Hai
summary_bullets: Bihar mein rozgar ki samasya bahut badi hai
15-20 hazaar ki job ke liye logon ko shahar chhodna pad raha hai
Sarkar ko is samasya ka samadhan nikalna hoga

history.title: Bihar Ke Sarkari Schoolon Ki Haalath: Jhopdi Mein Class, Tin Shed Ke Neeche Padhai
summary_bullets: Bihar ke kai sarkari schoolon mein abhi bhi jhopdi mein class chal rahe hain
Tin shed ke neeche padhai ho rahi hai, jo bachchon ke liye surakshit nahin hai
Sarkar ko is samasya ka samadhan nikalna hoga

history.title: Bihar Mein Bada Panchayat Chunav Se Pehle Gaon Ka Naksha Badalne Ki Taiyaari
summary_bullets: Bihar ke gaon mein pariseeman se aarakshan mein bada badlav hone wala hai
Panchayat chunav se pehle gaon ke naksha ko badalne ki taiyaari hai
Isse gaon ke vikas mein naye avsar aayenge
